name: Truyen Kieu
description: Kiet tac tho luc bat cua dai thi hao Nguyen Du, ke ve cuoc doi day truan chuyen cua nang Kieu. Tac pham van hoc kinh dien Viet Nam, the hien sau sac than phan nguoi phu nu phong kien. Phu hop voi nguoi yeu van hoc co dien, hoc sinh sinh vien khoi xa hoi.

name: Tat Den
description: Tieu thuyet hien thuc phe phan noi tieng cua Ngo Tat To, mo ta cuoc song bi tham cua tang lop nong dan duoi che do thuc dan phong kien. Tac pham co gia tri lich su va nhan dao sau sac, thuong duoc giang day trong chuong trinh ngu van.

name: Chi Pheo
description: Truyen ngan kinh dien cua Nam Cao, ke ve bi kich cua nguoi nong dan bi tha hoa boi xa hoi phong kien. Mot trong nhung tac pham van hoc hien thuc phe phan tieu bieu, dam tinh nhan ban va trien ly nhan sinh sau sac.

name: Nha Gia Kim
description: Tieu thuyet truyen cam hung quoc te ve chang chan cuu Santiago tren hanh trinh tim kho bau, kham pha y nghia cuoc song. Cuon sach best-seller toan cau, duoc dich ra hon 80 thu tieng. Phu hop nguoi tim dong luc, tu duy tich cuc.

name: Dac Nhan Tam
description: Cuon sach kinh dien ve nghe thuat giao tiep va doi nhan xu the cua Dale Carnegie, ban chay nhat the gioi suot gan 100 nam. Day cach gay anh huong, ket ban va xay dung quan he tot dep. Phu hop sinh vien, nhan vien van phong, lanh dao.

name: Clean Code
description: Sach kinh dien ve viet code sach, de bao tri, de doc tu Uncle Bob. Cung cap nguyen tac, pattern va thuc hanh tot cho lap trinh vien chuyen nghiep. Must-read cho moi developer muon nang cao chat luong code va tro thanh software craftsman.

name: Python Crash Course
description: Khoa hoc Python toan dien tu co ban den nang cao, gom 3 du an thuc te: game alien invasion, data visualization, web app Django. Phu hop nguoi moi bat dau hoc lap trinh hoac muon chuyen sang Python.

name: Cha Giau Cha Ngheo
description: Best-seller ve tai chinh ca nhan cua Robert Kiyosaki, day cach tu duy ve tien va dau tu khac voi nguoi binh thuong. Phan biet asset va liability, cach lam viec de tien lam viec cho minh. Phu hop ai muon doc lap tai chinh.

name: Nghi Giau Lam Giau
description: Bi quyet thanh cong cua Napoleon Hill duoc rut tu nghien cuu 500 nha tu phu My. 13 nguyen tac de bien y tuong thanh tien bac, su nghiep va hanh phuc. Tac pham kinh dien ve phat trien ban than va lam giau bang tu duy.

name: Doraemon Tap 1
description: Truyen tranh manga noi tieng Nhat Ban ve chu meo may Doraemon den tu the ky 22 va cau be Nobita. Day be tinh ban, long tot va su sang tao qua nhung bao boi than ky. Phu hop tre em tu 6 tuoi tro len.

name: Conan Tap 1
description: Truyen tranh trinh tham noi tieng cua Gosho Aoyama ve tham tu trung hoc Shinichi Kudo bi bien thanh tre em va lay ten Conan Edogawa. Phu hop thanh thieu nien yeu trinh tham, suy luan logic.

name: Design Patterns
description: Sach kinh dien ve 23 design pattern huong doi tuong tu nhom Gang of Four (Gamma, Helm, Johnson, Vlissides). Cung cap reusable solution cho cac bai toan phan mem thuong gap. Must-read cho software architect va developer senior.

name: Tuoi Tre Dang Gia Bao Nhieu
description: Cam nang song cho gioi tre Viet Nam cua Rosie Nguyen, chia se ve dinh huong nghe nghiep, tinh yeu, hoc tap va du lich. Phu hop sinh vien dai hoc va nguoi moi di lam dang tim phuong huong cuoc song.

name: Sapiens
description: Luoc su loai nguoi cua Yuval Noah Harari, ke ve hanh trinh tu Homo sapiens den van minh hien dai. Kham pha ba cuoc cach mang lon: nhan thuc, nong nghiep, khoa hoc. Best-seller toan cau ve lich su va trien hoc.

name: Cho Toi Xin Mot Ve Di Tuoi Tho
description: Truyen dai cua nha van Nguyen Nhat Anh ve nhung ky niem tuoi tho dep va vui nhon. Hoai niem ve thoi tho au voi tro choi, ban be, gia dinh. Phu hop ca tre em va nguoi lon muon song lai tuoi tho.

name: iPhone 15 Pro 256GB
description: Smartphone flagship cua Apple voi chip A17 Pro 3nm, camera 48MP, khung titan nhe, USB-C, man hinh Super Retina XDR 6.1 inch ProMotion. Hieu nang manh me cho gaming, ai task, quay phim 4K ProRes. Bao hanh 12 thang chinh hang.

name: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra
description: Flagship Android cua Samsung voi but S Pen, zoom optical 5x va digital 100x, chip Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, RAM 12GB, man hinh Dynamic AMOLED 2X 6.8 inch. Tich hop Galaxy AI cho dich thuat va chinh sua anh. Bao hanh 12 thang.

name: iPad Air M2 11 inch
description: Tablet Apple iPad Air voi chip M2, man hinh Liquid Retina 11 inch, ho tro Apple Pencil Pro va Magic Keyboard. Phu hop hoc tap, ve thiet ke, xem phim va lam viec di dong. Bao hanh 12 thang chinh hang Apple.

name: MacBook Air M3 13 inch
description: Laptop sieu mong va nhe cua Apple voi chip M3 hieu nang cao, pin 18 gio, man hinh Liquid Retina 13.6 inch. Im lang, khong quat tan nhiet, phu hop sinh vien, developer, designer. Bao hanh 12 thang chinh hang.

name: Dell XPS 15
description: Laptop cao cap cho cong viec sang tao voi RTX 4060, Intel Core i7-13700H, RAM 16GB, SSD 1TB, man hinh OLED 3.5K. Phu hop video editor, 3D artist, software engineer chuyen nghiep. Bao hanh 24 thang.

name: ASUS ROG Strix G16
description: Laptop gaming cao cap cua ASUS ROG voi RTX 4070, Intel Core i9, RAM 16GB DDR5, SSD 512GB, man hinh 16 inch 240Hz. Tan nhiet ROG Intelligent Cooling. Phu hop gamer, streamer va e-sports. Bao hanh 24 thang.

name: Ao so mi nam Owen
description: Ao so mi nam cong so cua thuong hieu Owen, chat lieu cotton 100% thoang mat, dang slim fit lich su. Co cac mau co dien: trang, xanh nhat, kem. Phu hop di lam, di tiec hoac mac thuong ngay. Bao hanh chat luong.

name: Quan tay nam Aristino
description: Quan tay nam cong so cua Aristino, chat lieu wool blend cao cap, dang straight fit chuan form. Phu hop mac voi ao so mi va giay tay cho moi truong cong so chinh thuc, di tiec, di gap khach hang.

name: Giay tay nam DUNK
description: Giay tay nam cao cap cua DUNK, da bo that 100% mem mai, de cao su ben va chong truot. Mau nau co dien, phu hop mac voi vest, quan tay di lam hoac di su kien. Co bao hanh duong may va keo dan.

name: Ao thun nu Routine
description: Ao thun nu basic cua Routine, chat cotton 100% mem mai, form regular thoai mai. Co nhieu mau pastel de phoi do. Phu hop mac di hoc, di choi, mac nha. Bao hanh chat luong vai khong nhao mau khi giat.

name: Vay maxi nu Elise
description: Vay maxi nu du tiec cua Elise, chat lieu lua mem ruot rao, dang xoe nu tinh kieu cong chua. Phu hop di tiec cuoi, su kien, hop lop. Co cac mau pastel: hong nhat, xanh mint, kem. Co the giat tay.

name: Tui xach nu Charles & Keith
description: Tui xach nu cong so cua thuong hieu Singapore Charles & Keith, chat lieu da PU cao cap kim loai khoa vang. Dung tich vua phai du chua laptop 13 inch, vi, son moi. Phu hop di lam, di hen ho, di shopping. Bao hanh 6 thang.
